title: ESO/ESMINT Guideline 2024: Acute Management of Basilar Artery Occlusion

recommendations.text: Expert consensus suggests using IVT up to 24 h in basilar artery occlusion unless otherwise contraindicated, and suggests IVT plus endovascular treatment over direct EVT.
ESO suggests EVT plus best medical treatment over BMT alone, derived from patients with NIHSS >=10 and a low proportion of IVT in the BMT arm.
For patients with NIHSS below 10 there was no evidence to recommend EVT over BMT; BMT was non-significantly better and safer than EVT.
A stronger treatment effect of EVT plus BMT over BMT alone was observed for proximal and middle basilar occlusion compared with distal location.
Expert consensus suggests AGAINST reperfusion therapy in patients with extensive bilateral and/or brainstem ischaemic changes; reperfusion is suggested regardless of collateral scores.

recommendations.classNote: Source grading: Limited evidence / expert consensus.
recommendations.text: Direct aspiration is suggested over stent retriever as first-line mechanical thrombectomy strategy; rescue angioplasty and/or stenting is suggested after a failed EVT procedure.
